title: 3 Kesalahan Video Produk HP yang Bikin Orang Tidak Jadi Beli

slides.headline: Video Produk HP Kamu Tampak Murah?
slides.body: Masalahnya bukan di kameranya, tapi 3 kesalahan fatal ini. Swipe untuk perbaiki!
slides.image_prompt: Split screen image comparing a dark low-quality smartphone product video side-by-side with a glossy cinematic studio product video. Modern typography with dark slate blue tone aesthetic.
slides.layout: Split-screen visual hook with bold modern headline overlay

slides.headline: 1. Lighting Asal-Asalan
slides.body: Mengandalkan lampu kamar bikin produk terlihat kusam dan penuh bayangan. Selalu manfaatkan cahaya alami jendela atau softbox light.
slides.image_prompt: A smartphone setup showing bad yellow overhead room light vs clean soft directional lighting on a luxury product.
slides.layout: Top visual comparison image with bottom high-contrast body text box

slides.headline: 2. Cuma Pakai 1 Angle Monoton
slides.body: Merekam dari satu sudut saja membuat penonton cepat bosan dalam 3 detik. Kombinasikan Wide Shot, Medium Shot, dan Detail Close-up.
slides.image_prompt: Infographic graphic depicting 3 camera grid frame angles around a product: Establishing shot, feature shot, and close-up detail.
slides.layout: Left graphic diagram with right-aligned bulleted explanation

slides.headline: 3. Transisi & Pacing Lambat
slides.body: Video terasa membosankan karena dead air tidak dipotong dan ritme video tidak selaras dengan beat audio.
slides.image_prompt: Close up of a smartphone video editing app timeline displaying audio beats and precision trim cuts.
slides.layout: Center mobile screen visual overlay with dark sleek text container

slides.headline: Solusi: Gunakan Formula 4 Shot Sederhana
slides.body:
1. Hook visual (0-2s)
2. Detail produk (3-5s)
3. Produk saat digunakan (6-10s)
4. Call to Action jelas (11-15s)
slides.image_prompt: Clean minimalist visual flow diagram showing 4 storyboarding steps numbered 1 to 4 with sleek icons.

slides.headline: Ingin Video Produk HP Kamu Berkelas Iklan TV?
slides.body: Gak ada waktu edit sendiri? Serahkan pada ahlinya. Hubungi Bos Sony Creative Studio sekarang!
slides.image_prompt: Professional creative studio workstation showcase with sleek branding logo and prominent CTA button graphic.
slides.layout: Full contrast closing card layout with prominent CTA button design
